newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African average T-Bill rate 15.24 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.African average T-Bill rate 15.24 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for South African three-month Treasury Bills fell to 15.24 percent at the latest weekly tender after rising to 15.47 percent last week, the Reserve Bank said.
Applications for the 800 million rand of bills on offer totalled 2.6 billion rand. The average price was 96.200 rand percent.

The average rate for six-month bills was 14.66 percent from 14.88 percent. Applications for the 300 million rand of bills on offer totalled 1.24 billion rand. The average price was 92.690 rand percent.
